tests.scope: Eight repair regression tests plus 29 delivery/runtime tests: exact jaw and root repair replay, original sculpt/UV/rig/articulation preservation, original jaw and contact defect detection, offset 480 Hz support checks, eight frozen face regions across clips and 468 blends, resolver and all-161 delivery metadata.

findings: Stone Turtle lower beak/chin drift was confirmed on the independently frozen original and repaired with continuous face weights. Actual production windup/strike/recover then revealed floor penetration; calibrated only three vertical root curves and disabled duplicate host crouch using baked-support flags. Original sculpt, UVs, bind rig and limb articulation remain intact. Pebble is a separate model.
limits: Two sampled visual passes of all thirteen authored clips, front/both-side head views and front/side full body. Second pass also covers all sixteen production runtime rows at low/medium quality, 216 actual equipped-technique frames, 24 advancing companion-idle frames and 16 atlas cells. Eight frozen facial regions checked through all clips and 468 blends in each model version. This is local evidence; main/live verification remains pending and the full 161-pet audit remains open.
